diagnosticMetric.scope: Mean per-channel absolute difference between columns x-1 and x at y730:850, terrain-camera-1800.png; not a global image-quality score

findings.observation: MI06 and MI07 characters can be occluded by the existing walker and ambulance when their simulated positions overlap. Source boards and grounding view remain readable. No object position, collision or render layer was altered to hide this.
Existing vector industrial silhouettes remain conspicuous above the painted Vesper terrain. They predate this lot and are not replaced by the new panorama/terrain sprites.
